name: labelSets
description: Distinct combinations of a set of labels across current series, one row per combination, used to index objects

getArgs.value: {{dataSource[pack] === false ? 'vector(0)' : 'count by (' + (labels + (extraLabels ? ',' + extraLabels : '')).split(',').flatMap(l => l.split('/')).map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && l !== '-').join(',') + ') (' + (match || '{' + required.split(',').map(l => l.trim() + '!=""').join(',') + '}') + ')'}}

ui.name: pack
ui.label: Index pack
ui.help: The **Objects to index** option that enables this label set, e.g. `indexK8s`.

ui.name: labels
ui.label: Labels
ui.help: Comma-separated label names to group by, e.g. `cluster,namespace,pod`. A label may list alternatives separated by `/`, e.g. `cluster/k8s.cluster.name`; the first non-empty one is used.

ui.name: keys
ui.label: Property names
ui.help: Comma-separated property names for each label, in the same order as **Labels**.

ui.name: required
ui.label: Required labels
ui.help: Comma-separated labels that must be non-empty for a series to count.

ui.name: nameKey
ui.label: Name property
ui.help: The property (or comma-separated properties, joined with ' / ') used as the object name.

ui.name: aliases
ui.label: Alias label sets
ui.help: `|`-separated alternative label names for the same properties (`-` for not present). Used to build a scoping selector that also matches other naming conventions.

ui.name: match
ui.label: Series selector override
ui.help: Optional selector to count instead of the default `{required!=""}`, e.g. `up`.

ui.name: extraLabels
ui.label: Extra labels
ui.help: Comma-separated labels stored as properties but not part of the object identity, e.g. `service.namespace`.

ui.name: extraKeys
ui.label: Extra property names
ui.help: Property names for **Extra labels**, in the same order.
